prose: It's time to take a look at Sagittarius signatures, with our resident herbalists, Kyle Denton of Tippecanoe Herbs and Ms. Lundquist of Michelle's Healing Home. Mario Garza of Symbolic Studies will be in the mix too, adding his observations about the season of the far-sighted archer.
